We are hiring for a Managed Care Customer Service Representative to join our growing team!
Job Description
This is an in office role that is responsible for providing customers, retail personnel, and insurance companies detailed information regarding invoices and explanations of balance due.
What Would You Do? The Specifics.
Answers calls from customers regarding collection of past account accounts. Conducts conference calls with customers and insurance companies to determine the the responsible party for the balance and offers solutions of payment options.
Provides detailed notes in our Point of System to communicate findings to retail associates and maintains notes in the ticketing system to track calls and the purpose of calls.
Answers calls from retail personnel to assist with selecting the correct plans in the Point of Sale system and answer questions regarding plan calculations and why their customers received balance due notices.
Writes off balance per store requests concerning store errors and forwards new plans to the Plan Setup Team to add into the Point of Sale.
Answers calls from third-party payers and reviews line by line the details in order to determine the customer's responsibility and insurance responsibility.
Completes a high-balance investigation to find new ways to prevent bad billings by researching insurance plans and insurance information. Makes outbound calls to insurance companies to inquire about the status of unpaid self-pay claims.
Solves issues with insurance checks that go directly to the customers but belong to National Vision (NVI) by calling out to the customers to explain their balances owed.

High School Diploma or equivalent. (Required)

As the Manager, Quality Assurance within Customer Support, you will play a key role in shaping how we measure, maintain, and improve the quality of our customer experience across every support interaction.

You’ll lead the evolution of our QA program, helping define the frameworks, processes, and operational strategies that enable our teams to deliver consistent, high-quality support at scale.

By leveraging AI-powered QA tooling, you’ll surface actionable insights, identify emerging themes, and help drive continuous improvements in support quality and team performance.
Our QA program is still in its early stages, with foundational processes already in place but significant opportunity to iterate, expand, and mature the function over time. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in evolving environments and is excited by the opportunity to help shape a modern QA program while balancing strategic ownership with hands-on execution.
Reporting into Customer Support leadership, you will partner closely with Support Operations, frontline leaders, Enablement, Product, and other cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for operational improvement, coaching, and quality enhancements across the customer journey. You’ll help establish scalable QA methodologies, calibration practices, reporting structures, and feedback loops that drive accountability and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
In this role, you’ll also help shape how QA supports AI-powered customer experiences. As AI-assisted workflows and responses continue to evolve, you’ll evaluate both human and AI-generated customer interactions to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with the customer experience we aim to deliver. Your ability to identify trends, uncover friction points, and drive targeted quality initiatives will directly influence both team effectiveness and customer experience.
This role has the potential to evolve into direct people leadership of QA specialists or QA team leads as the function grows.
How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster.

AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.
This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

5+ years of experience in quality assurance, customer support, customer experience, or service operations within a fast-paced environment.
3+ years of leadership experience, including managing individual contributors or senior-level team members.
Proven experience building, scaling, or evolving QA programs and frameworks within customer support or customer experience organizations.
Strong understanding of quality assurance methodologies, calibration practices, coaching models, and performance management.
Experience supporting omnichannel customer support environments, including chat, email, messaging, and voice.
Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting QA results, performance metrics, and customer feedback to drive operational improvements.
Experience working with AI-enabled support tools and comfort evaluating the effectiveness and quality of AI-assisted customer interactions.
Experience building or deploying AI-driven coaching and enablement solutions that surface performance insights, reinforce quality standards, and help support teams continuously improve at scale.
Hands-on experience with CRM and support platforms such as Zendesk, along with familiarity with QA platforms and AI-enabled support technologies.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and aligning teams around operational improvements.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and evolving environments where iteration, adaptability, and problem-solving are essential.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a rapidly evolving organization.
Located in Atlantic, Eastern or Central timezones (AT, ET or CT).

Define, evolve, and operationalize a centralized quality assurance strategy across customer support channels, including email, chat, messaging, and voice.
Iterate on and maintain QA frameworks, scorecards, audit methodologies, and calibration processes that drive consistency, accountability, and high-quality customer experiences.
Analyze QA results, customer interactions, CSAT trends, and operational performance data to identify coaching opportunities, process improvements, and targeted areas requiring additional QA oversight.
Identify high-impact moments across the customer journey where deeper QA focus is needed, including low CSAT interactions, escalations, complex workflows, or AI-assisted conversations.
Partner with Support Operations and frontline leadership to translate QA insights into actionable recommendations, operational improvements, and ongoing training opportunities.
Evaluate both team member and AI-generated customer interactions to ensure responses are accurate, effective, compliant, and aligned with quality standards and brand expectations.
Help shape how AI tooling is incorporated into support workflows, using QA insights and performance data to improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency.
Develop reporting, analyses, and presentations that communicate QA performance, trends, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership teams.

Kiavi is one of the nation’s largest private lenders to residential real estate investors (REIs). We harness the power of data & technology to offer our customers a simpler, more reliable, and faster way to access the capital they need to scale their businesses.

Formerly known as LendingHome, we’re committed to helping REIs revitalize the approximately $25 trillion worth of aged U.S. housing stock to provide move-in ready homes and rental housing for millions of Americans across the country.

Combining our technology and industry expertise, Kiavi has grown to a team of over 500 and has won many awards over the years including Forbes Fintech 50, Finovate Awards, Best Digital Mortgage Platform, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and many more.

Loans Funded: $30 billion in loans funded

Homes financed: 100,000+ projects funded for our customers across the country

Geography: 49 states + D.C. where we lend to REIs so they can revitalize neighborhoods

Employees: Over 500 employees with competitive benefits and perks
This position can be based remotely in any of our approved hiring regions. Our hybrid distributed workforce philosophy allows us to find the best talent in the country and build diverse teams, while allowing our colleagues to work from the location that works best for them.

Identity Verification Notice: To ensure the security and integrity of our hiring process, all candidates are required to complete a secure identity verification. This process uses biometric and device validation to confirm identity and liveness. All data is handled securely in accordance with our privacy policy.

The Role The Kiavi Customer Experience organization is rooted in three core principles ; Doing the Right Thing, Commitment to Excellence and Winning as a Team. Each teammate centers their work around trying to make a difference in the lives of each and every customer daily - through helping them successfully secure financing and grow their business.

Kiavi is seeking an experienced relationship manager who thrives in serving customers to maximize their potential. This person should thrive in chaos, Successful candidates should possess the ability to organize competing priorities and tasks, be a self starter, result-oriented, and when in doubt always do right by the customer.

You will be responsible for delivering a best-in-class customer experience while ensuring Kiavi is the selected partner for customer's current and future projects and needs.

Through our commitment to service and best-in-class technology, you will be responsible for acquiring, retaining and growing your customers’ business with Kiavi and demonstrating why Kiavi is the best partner to serve their mortgage needs. Responsibilities
Proactively build your borrower “book of business” - comprised of passionate real estate investors looking to grow their own businesses
Operate as “Champion of the Customer” for all borrower needs
Engage and support your clients’ needs - on their timetables - including occasional weekend and evening coverage
Advise borrowers throughout the origination experience - particularly as it relates to pricing, valuation, rehab project scope-of-work
Attend local and regional industry events - including REA meetings and conference
Delivering a complete loan application file ready for underwriting
Driving higher repeat business to produce incremental growth to each borrower relationship
Contribute to projects that improve the business and effectiveness of the team
Partnering with your customers to qualify for the right mortgage for their situation, obtain required documentation, and guide them through the application process
Operate as the champion for any and all matters specific to your customers
Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships as the result of being a trusted advisor
Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives
Deliver and own communication for material updates (e.g. new state licensing, new product, process changes, credit policy)
Work cross functionally with the Operations team to help resolve and mitigate any customer or loan issues
Support and empower to your teammates in order to win as a team

CRM or Salesforce experience
College degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, or relevant experience
Passion for Real Estate investing
Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation skills
Set high standards for yourself matched with exceptional interpersonal skills
Ability to adapt in a dynamic and growing organization
High empathy and desire to help others
Experience in formulating and presenting solutions based on customer needs
Proven ability to manage multiple projects at a time while demonstrating strong attention to detail
Kiavi takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. The expected annualized base pay range for this full-time role to be performed remotely is $40,000 to $60,000 + $3,000 bonus + benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries.

Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Your recruiter can share more about the specific base pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Please note that the pay range listed above reflects the base salary only, and does not include the target value of bonus or benefits. Benefits and Perks

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Kiavi offers free employee-only coverage for medical, dental, and vision plans. Dependents receive a heavily discounted premium, competitively placed in the 90th percentile for cost.

Health Savings Account (HSA): For those enrolled in a High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP), Kiavi provides an annual employer contribution to HSAs: $1,000 for individual coverage and $2,000 for dependents.

Disability and Life Insurance: Immediate access to short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as group life and AD&D insurance, with coverage at 1x annual salary.

Remote Work Policy: Kiavi supports working remotely for day to day activities for most roles and occasionally may ask employees to gather in person for key meetings, training, team building etc. For remote workers, Kiavi offers a one-time office setup reimbursement of up to $500 and a monthly $85 stipend for internet and phone expenses. For in-office workers, Kiavi offers employer contributions to commuter benefits account, either for parking or public transportation.

Flexible Time Off: Employees are empowered to manage their own time off, with no strict limits, as long as it's approved by their manager.

Paid Leaves: Up to 8 weeks of paid leave for medical or caregiver purposes, and 12 weeks of paid maternity/paternity leave. Short-term disability leave is also available for birthing mothers.

401(k) & Company Match: A 401(k) plan managed by Fidelity, with Kiavi matching 100% of contributions up to 3% of compensation or $8,000 (whichever is less). All employer contributions are immediately vested.

Powering the Pacific Northwest: Be the Force Behind Our Federal Workforce! Step into a pivotal role at the heart of the Pacific Northwest's energy future. Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) is renowned for providing an abundant, efficient, and reliable power supply, all while championing environmental stewardship.

Our work powers millions of homes and businesses throughout the Pacific Northwest. To achieve this mission, we need a dedicated and talented workforce. As an Operations Support Specialist on one of our Human Resources teams, you will be a key player in hiring, developing, and supporting the incredible people who keep the lights on.

This is more than a job; it's a launchpad for your federal HR career. You will gain hands-on experience and develop a broad foundation of skills in a dynamic, supportive environment. Your work will directly impact the well-being of our employees and the success of our organization.

As part of a team, you will learn one of the core functions of federal human resources from the ground up. As an Operations Support Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of our HR team.

While all roles share core responsibilities in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our employee data, you will be assigned to a specialized team where you can deepen your expertise.

Your specific duties will be focused within one of the following key HR functions: Core Responsibilities (All Teams): Be a Guardian of Data Integrity: Process a wide range of personnel actions with precision, interpreting federal guidelines to apply correct processing codes and legal justifications, ensuring every detail is accurate and every employee's record is secure.

Potential Areas of Specialization: Recruitment and Placement: Shape our workforce by playing a direct role in attracting top talent. You'll prepare recruitment packages, draft compelling job announcements for a variety of federal roles, and ensure a smooth and compliant hiring process.

Classification and Position Management: Master the art of organizational design by helping to determine appropriate job titles, series, and pay grades, ensuring fairness and equity across the agency.

Benefits: Guide employees through their most important career milestones by helping them navigate federal benefits and retirement options, ensuring they have the information needed to plan for their future.

Training and Development: Champion employee growth by helping to identify training needs, coordinating logistics for virtual and in-person courses, and providing direct support to our New Employee Orientation program.

Employee and Labor Relations: Build critical skills by researching and analyzing information, providing recommendations on employee matters, and gaining foundational experience in awards and recognition programs.

Compliance and Records Management: Sharpen your analytical skills by participating in HR program audits, helping to identify and resolve discrepancies to ensure our operations meet the highest federal standards.
EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: GS-05: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least 3 years of progressively responsible experience, 1 year of which was equivalent to at least GS-4, that demonstrates the ability to: Analyze problems to identify significant factors, gather pertinent data, and recognize solutions; Plan and organize work; and Communicate effectively orally and in writing.

You may substitute education for specialized experience as follows: 4-year course of study leading to a bachelor's degree or a bachelor's degree. GS-07: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level (GS-05) in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as: experience 1) applying organizational policies and procedures to process a range of personnel or administrative actions; AND 2) providing frontline support for a human resources function (e.g. staffing, benefits administration, employee records, employee/labor relations, etc.) and responding to routine inquiries from employees, managers, or customers.

You may substitute education for specialized experience as follows: One year of graduate-level education, or superior academic achievement (S.A.A.) gained in a bachelor degree curriculum that is qualifying for the position to be filled (based on class standing, grade-point average, or honor society membership).

See the following link for more information: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-policies/#url=app -OR- Combination of education and experience as described above. Less than one year of specialized experience may be combined with completed graduate education.

"Experience" refers to paid and unpaid experience. Examples of qualifying unpaid experience may include: volunteer work done through National Service programs (such as Peace Corps and AmeriCorps); as well as work for other community-based philanthropic and social organizations.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills; and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

You must meet all qualifications and eligibility requirements by the closing date of this announcement.

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply - we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort.

Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

If a service does not meet contracted specifications or a process falls short of expected results, the CSM proactively intervenes to drive a resolution. As a Front Line Manager you will: Plan work to be accomplished by subordinates, sets and adjusts short-term priorities and prepares schedules for completion of work. Assign work to subordinates based on priorities, selective consideration of the difficulty and requirements of assignments, and the capabilities of employees.

Evaluate work performance of subordinates and makes recommendations for outstanding performance recognition and/or disciplinary action. Give advice, counsel or instruction to employees on work and administrative matters.

Interview candidates for positions within the organization/unit and recommend appointment, promotion or reassignment to such positions. Hear and resolve complaints from employees, refer group grievances and/or more serious unresolved complaints as appropriate.

Effect minor disciplinary measures, such as warnings and reprimands, recommend other actions in more serious cases. Identify developmental and training needs of employees, providing or arranging for needed development and training. Initiate ways to improve production, work processes and/or to increase the quality of the work directed.

The following are the job specific duties of this position. You will have the opportunity to learn to perform these duties and receive training to help you grow in this position.

Provides technical oversight of taxpayer inquiries and case resolution activities by evaluating work performed and ensuring consistent application of tax laws, regulations, and IRM procedures.

Reviews and analyzes cases involving multiple issue areas, complex regulatory requirements, and frequently changing guidance to ensure accurate and compliant resolution. Ensures employees follow established procedures for handling inventory, system usage, and case documentation requirements.

Applies advanced interviewing and analytical techniques to evaluate taxpayer circumstances, including sensitive financial and personal information, and to determine appropriate actions. Ensures proper handling of cases involving issues such as compliance determinations, financial hardship, or potential noncompliance.

Evaluates determinations made by employees to ensure sound judgment in resolving discrepancies and interpreting taxpayer intent. Ensures proper handling of sensitive taxpayer data and reinforces adherence to disclosure and privacy regulations in all case interactions.

Analyzes casework, workload data, and program trends to identify risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement. Supports the development of strategies to improve efficiency, consistency, and program effectiveness.

Utilizes system-generated reports and operational data to monitor trends, identify systemic issues, and recommend corrective actions to improve program performance. Ensures accurate computation or review of tax liabilities, penalties, and assessments across a range of tax situations.

Provides technical guidance and support to employees, promoting consistent application of policies and procedures and assisting with complex or unusual cases. Advises employees on interpretation of IRM procedures, SERP guidance, and other program resources to ensure accurate and consistent case resolution.

Maintains technical proficiency by performing work consistently with the level of employees supervised, as needed. Participates in ongoing technical training and remains current on tax law changes, procedural updates, and program requirements.

This position requires a deep understanding of fleet management software, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts effectively.

The ideal candidate for this role has served as the primary point of contact for basic technical support and product-related inquiries from customers in the software space. We are looking for a Customer Service Representative to support customer accounts throughout the order fulfillment process. In this role, you will be responsible for processing purchase orders, coordinating with internal teams, monitoring order and shipping status, and ensuring customers receive timely and accurate updates.
The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive in communication, and comfortable coordinating across multiple teams to ensure customer requirements and delivery commitments are met.

Coordinate same-day with the Production Scheduler and Materials Manager to ensure orders are created and lead times are confirmed.
Send order acknowledgments to customers via email or customer portals.
Customer Communication & Support
Respond to customer requests, questions, and complaints on the same business day.
Investigate customer inquiries by coordinating with relevant internal teams and gathering the required information.
Clearly communicate timelines and provide updates when additional information or more time is needed to resolve a customer request.
Maintain professional, proactive, and timely communication with customers throughout the order process.
Customer Release & Schedule Management
Review, modify, and update customer blanket release schedules as needed.
Process customer releases received through EDI, customer portals, and email .
Ensure customer schedules and requirements are accurately reflected in internal systems.
Order & Delivery Monitoring
Review current and two-week future shipping lines to monitor on-time delivery performance .
Identify potential delays or risks to customer delivery dates.
Proactively communicate delays to customers and coordinate internally to determine realistic recovery timelines.
Follow up on recovery plans to ensure customer commitments are met.
Parts & Production Follow-Up
Track parts through OSS and monitor their progress to ensure timely processing.
Coordinate with OSS and relevant internal teams to identify potential issues and prevent delays.
Provide customers with accurate status updates when required.

The United States Space Force (USSF) in Washington D.C. is searching for a Mission Support Specialist to support DELTA 13 (NH-0343-03, GS-12/13 Equivalent). Description: Step to the leading edge of national defense and help architect the future of the United States Space Force.

In this high-impact strategic role, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge space and cyber operations and the Pentagon's resource allocation engine.

Your expertise will directly shape how the Space Force organizes, educates, and resources its total force-translating advanced operational concepts in Space Domain Awareness, Space ISR, and multi-domain warfare into fully funded, actionable programs across the Program Objective Memorandum (POM) and Future Years Defense Program (FYDP).

Ideal Candidate: The ideal candidate is a seasoned human capital strategist, academic program manager, or military space operations professional with extensive headquarters-, Field Command-, or Delta-level staff experience in Total Force management and specialized Administratively Determined (AD) personnel systems.

They possess deep expertise in the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process to build, defend, and integrate Space Force education, faculty pay requirements, and human capital initiatives into the Program Objectives Memorandum (POM) and Future Years Defense Program (FYDP).

Additionally, they bring proven capability in administering complex AD faculty personnel actions, managing academic selection boards, and synchronizing requirements across Space Delta 13, STARCOM, and higher headquarters. Key Responsibilities: 1.

Coordinates end-to-end personnel lifecycle actions for Administratively Determined (AD) Faculty, including recruitment, hiring authorities, salary determinations, appointments, contract extensions, onboarding, in/out-processing, and performance management across Senior Level Education programs.

Serves as the primary personnel liaison between faculty, academic leadership and Space Delta 13. 2. Applies Department of Defense Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) processes to forecast, formulate, and execute faculty personnel and operational budgets.

Develops Program Objectives Memoranda (POM) inputs, Budget Estimate Submissions (BES), cost projections, financial exhibits, and FYDP personnel projections/offsets for Delta 13 education programs. 3.

Synchronizes personnel actions and operational alignment for Joint military instructors, Active Duty Guardians, and Total Force personnel assigned to or augmenting Space Force educational programs. Tracks suspense management, program records, and cross-service instructor memorandums of agreement (MOAs/MOUs). 4.

Integrates Space Delta 13 faculty footprint, academic facility requirements, and classroom technology requirement. 5. Develops and standardizes Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), governance charters, business rules, and administrative tracking systems for the emerging Space Force education enterprise.

Coordinates high-level academic meetings, faculty symposiums, and Distinguished Visitor (DV) engagements. 6. Analyzes complex programmatic, personnel, and fiscal data to identify operational gaps and formulate actionable courses of action (COAs).

Drafts executive correspondence and staff summary sheets for Space Delta 13 leadership and higher headquarters.

Join Angel City VA — Where Top Clinical Research Talent Gets Discovered.
Angel City VA is a Los Angeles-based, fast-scaling virtual support platform built to power the next generation of clinical research. We partner with independent research sites, sponsors, and CROs to deliver the high-quality remote clinical trial support that keeps studies moving, and demand for our services is growing fast.

Our team thrives in a high-energy, fast-paced, and genuinely collaborative environment where sharp, driven professionals do work that matters: advancing the trials that bring new treatments to patients who need it the most.

This is your chance to grow alongside a company that is expanding rapidly across the world and investing in the people who make it run.
Here’s the key thing to know: we are actively building a database of high-caliber, pre-qualified candidates from which we draw to staff independent research sites as new opportunities come online. Applying now puts you on our radar early.

When the right study or site need arises, we reach out first to the standout talent already in our global pipeline. If you’re ambitious, detail-obsessed, passionate about cutting-edge, scientifically-rigorous, and ethical patient care and ready to be part of something scaling fast, we want to meet you.

We are seeking experienced remote professionals (2-3 years of experience, medical/biopharmaceutical background, and with completed and current GCP and HIPAA training) to support independent clinical research sites, sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and healthcare organizations across a wide range of clinical trial operations functions.
This is a multi-disciplinary opportunity designed to identify candidates with expertise in one or more areas of clinical research, patient engagement, regulatory support, study operations, finance, administration, and sponsor relations. Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area listed below.
Applicants should clearly indicate in their resume and cover letter which functional areas best match their experience and qualifications. Successful candidates will submit 3 references from previous clinical trial positions and will facilitate background checks as needed.

Angel City VA supports the full clinical trial lifecycle. The functional areas below reflect the services we provide to our research-site partners. Tell us where your strengths are. We can’t wait to learn about you.

· Walk participants through study procedures and visit expectations at each stage of the trial.

· Support the informed-consent process and patient education initiatives.

· Deliver retention touchpoints and follow-up across the full study timeline.

· Answer participant questions and facilitate communication between patients and study teams.
Visit Scheduling & Coordination

· Book participant visits within protocol-defined windows.

· Send appointment reminders and confirmations.

· Conduct proactive follow-up to reduce no-shows and missed visits.

· Track attendance, book transportation, and resolve scheduling conflicts.

· Assist with scheduled patient visits by walking on-site medical staff through protocol-required procedures and documenting visits in electronic source and other systems as needed.
Patient Recruitment & Pre-Screening

· Conduct outreach to prospective study participants.

· Review charts, databases, and referral sources.

· Perform preliminary eligibility screening against study inclusion/exclusion criteria.

· Consult with principal and sub-investigators on suitability of patients for a trial.

· Schedule screening appointments and document recruitment activity.

· Minimize screen failure and maximize patient enrollment and retention.
Study Lead Generation

· Source sponsor and CRO study opportunities.

· Support feasibility-questionnaire responses.

· Track the pipeline for new study awards.

· Research upcoming trials and potential new business.
EHR / EMR Management

· Update and maintain electronic medical records accurately.

· Provide documentation support and chart-completion assistance.

· Support record organization and documentation workflows.

· Maintain compliance with applicable privacy and regulatory requirements.

How to Prepare for the Recruiting Process -
📢 Why Are They Hiring an Insurance Customer Service Representative?
Our client is on a mission to bring calm to the chaos of commercial insurance—and they need a rockstar Customer Service Representative to help make that happen.

As their client base grows, so does the need for someone who can keep everything organized and on track: answering calls, replying to emails, processing billing and certificates, managing policy updates, and making sure renewals don’t slip through the cracks.

The team is lean, experienced, and high-performing—but they’re ready to hand off the operational load so they can stay focused on what matters.
This is your chance to be the backbone of the operation—bringing order, accuracy, and a personal touch to a team that truly values great service. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and love being the calm in the storm, this is where you belong. 🚀

Strong working knowledge of insurance operations, particularly in commercial lines
Familiarity with insurance terminology, policy documents, and servicing workflows
Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal—with the ability to handle client interactions professionally
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
Experience or exposure to construction or contractor insurance is a HUGE plus!
Ideally using Apple products (Mac, iPhone) and are fluent in tools like Numbers, Pages, and iMessage for seamless collaboration.
Responsibilities of the Insurance Customer Service Representative:

📞 Client Communication & Frontline Support
Serve as the first point of contact by answering inbound calls on the agency's main line; this may also include making outbound follow-up calls when necessary
Handle approximately 17–20 phone calls per day, ranging from quickinquiries to more in-depth conversations
Monitor and manage the shared service inbox, which is color-coded and collaboratively used by multiple team members
Triage, flag, and forward incoming emails appropriately; long-term expectation is for the Insurance CSR to assess incoming correspondence, identify required actions, and assign or tag tasks independently
Draft and send welcome emails to new clients
Retrieve and forward necessary documents from insurance carriers to internal service staff
Respond to client requests for Certificates of Insurance (COIs), additional insured endorsements, and proofs of insurance, ensuring accuracy and compliance
🛠️ Policy Servicing & Endorsements
Process a wide range of policy changes, including updates to addresses, names, business entities, or ownership structures
Submit, track, and follow up on endorsements and miscellaneous changes, working closely with carriers and internal stakeholders
Request and issue required auto filings as needed for commercial clients

Manage updates to commercial auto policies, including the addition or removal of drivers and vehicles.
Ensure all vehicle schedules are updated accurately in Veruna
💳 Billing, Payments & Compliance
Accept and process direct bill payments with the highest level of discretion, compliance, and data security
Maintain accurate logs of all financial transactions in the CRM and related systems
Generate and send invoices via email and DocuSign one to two times per week
Manage and process renewal invoices, confirmations, and direct bill (DB) cancellations
Maintain organized logs for login credentials, endorsements, renewals, and cancellations
🔁 Renewal Tracking & Support
Track and monitor upcoming renewals, particularly for direct bill or automatic policy renewals.
Record and update renewal details—including effective dates and premiums—into the CRM system
Upload and organize renewal documents (e.g., declarations pages, binders, ID cards) into both Veruna and Google Drive
Communicate renewal statuses to clients and support retention efforts through proactive follow-ups
Update certificate templates, contractor license boards (e.g., for Workers’ Comp policies), and internal spreadsheets to reflect current policy information
Coordinate with carriers such as Guard, Progressive, and Mercury to obtain renewal documents and ensure completeness of files.
🗂️ Data Management & Documentation
Collect and consolidate data from multiple insurance policies for processing and documentation
Upload endorsements and supporting documents into Veruna and Google Drive with precision and consistency
Regularly clean up and organize folders by archiving outdated certificates and ensuring file structures are up to date
Assist in the creation, maintenance, and refinement of internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to service and policy workflows
🏡 Want to Know More About the Client?
Our client is a modern-day trailblazer in the world of commercial insurance, serving contractors and small-to-medium businesses for over a decade across California, Arizona, Nevada, Texas, and beyond.

With a laser-sharp focus on compliance, renewals, and risk management, they’ve built their reputation on delivering boutique-style service with big-league results. From the high-stakes world of construction coverage to personalized risk consultancy, this lean, powerhouse agency brings clarity and confidence to its clients' insurance decisions.
Their mission? To simplify the complex, protect what matters, and scale smartly—without ever losing their human touch. Their remote team is tight-knit, upbeat, and motivated by one simple rule: take care of the customer, take care of each other, and take pride in your day’s work. 🌟

A Product Support Specialist is someone who is passionate about delivering outstanding day-to-day product support to our clients. Working closely with our Client Success Managers, you will be a key resource in helping clients get the most out of our platform, resolving issues quickly and efficiently, and ensuring a consistently excellent experience.

Handling Client Support Queries
Serving as a primary point of contact for day-to-day product support queries from clients
Triaging and resolving incoming support tickets promptly, maintaining exceptional customer service standards
Coordinating with our 24/7 offshore Support Team to ensure queries are handled efficiently and consistently
Escalating complex technical issues to the engineering team where necessary, providing clear context and documentation
Supporting Client Success Managers
Working closely with CSMs to ensure clients receive a seamless and high-quality experience
Assisting CSMs with account setup testing and configuration, liaising with the offshore Support Team as needed
Supporting the delivery of client training and UAT to ensure accounts are set up exactly as clients expect
Providing CSMs with timely updates on open support issues and flagging any patterns or recurring problems
Developing Outstanding Product Expertise
Developing thorough and in-depth knowledge of the Appointedd platform, including configuration, features, and common client use cases
Staying up to date with product changes and updates to ensure accurate and informed support
Liaising with the internal product team on technical fixes and maintaining a well-managed feedback loop from clients
Continuous Improvement
Identifying recurring issues or gaps in product knowledge and flagging these for internal review
Collaborating with all business teams to ensure a consistently high level of service is maintained
Contributing to the improvement of support processes, documentation, and internal knowledge bases

The Front-Line Operations Agent plays a vital customer-facing role, responsible for delivering high-quality support for a designated Lendable product, encompassing both general customer service and financial support.

You will follow established processes to resolve a variety of complex customer queries, ensuring interactions are efficient, accurate, and empathetic—applying your cross-functional expertise across general service needs and more intricate financial support situations.

By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys.

This role is key in ensuring our service continually evolves to better meet the needs of all customers. You’ll be based in our Chatham office , joining the team on-site three days a week .

You’ll work two weekends a month , but to keep your work-life balance in check, you’ll get a day in lieu the week before to ensure you never work more than five days a week.

Deliver exceptional support for a designated Lendable product, expertly handling a full spectrum of customer service and financial support queries via multiple channels, efficiently executing established processes.
Listen actively and provide clear, accurate responses, adapting communication style to each customer's needs, including those in vulnerable situations or with complex financial queries including customers in financial difficulty to ensure appropriate support solutions are implemented.
Take end-to-end ownership of customer interactions, ensuring every query is managed through to effective resolution or appropriate escalation.
Build rapport and trust while maintaining control of conversations, ensuring positive and compliant customer outcomes.
Ask effective probing questions to understand a customer’s financial circumstances and identify appropriate support options.
Work flexibly within your designated product area, adapting fluidly between general customer service and financial support requirements, and responding to varying service needs and complex customer queries.
Operational Excellence & Process Execution
Meet and exceed targets and KPIs related to customer satisfaction, quality, and compliance by consistently following key operational procedures and applying appropriate judgement to specific customer circumstances.
Effectively use AI and digital tools to streamline customer interactions and deliver faster, more accurate service.
Identify blockers, process gaps, or recurring issues and communicate these to relevant teams, supporting continuous improvement initiatives.
Log all interactions accurately and ensure data integrity for audit and learning purposes.
Continuous Improvement & Feedback
Provide clear, actionable feedback from frontline experiences to enhance our knowledge base, training resources, and AI systems.
Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to enhance the customer journey, automation, and operational efficiency.
Remain up to date with ongoing system, product, and process changes, readily adapting to evolving procedures.
Learning & Development
Respond positively to coaching and feedback, using it to improve performance and customer outcomes.
Demonstrate initiative in learning new tools, products, and procedures as they are introduced.
Share knowledge and support colleagues, helping to create a culture of collaborative learning.
Experience & Skills
Previous experience in a contact centre environment, with demonstrated experience in both customer service and financial support roles (or a combined equivalent), particularly within financial services.
Demonstrated ability to handle complex queries with empathy, accuracy, and ownership.
Confident in following structured processes and able to identify opportunities to improve them.
Strong communication, rapport-building, and conflict resolution skills.
Skilled in using digital tools and comfortable adopting new technologies, including AI-driven platforms.
Organised and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting.
Proactive in offering feedback and participating in process and AI improvement initiatives.
Behaviours & Approach
Customer-focused, with a passion for delivering consistent, positive outcomes.
Resilient, adaptable, and open to constant change and learning.
Collaborative, supportive team player committed to shared success.
High level of accountability and personal ownership for customer outcomes and process execution.
Constructive, solutions-focused approach with willingness to challenge the status quo.
